  Exam Date & Time: 11-May-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech IV Semester - End Semester Examination - April / May -2024  
  Linux Programming [CSE-4303]  
  Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Illustrate the working of two major components of Linux operating system in detail.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Outline the advantages of Linux operating system.                                          (3)  
  C)      Identify the type of following commands:  
  i) \$pwd  
  ii) \$chown                                                                                 (2)  
  iii) \$cp  
  iv) \$cat  
  
  2)           Solve the following using wild cards:  
  
  1. List all the filenames whose name starts with at least 2 characters and followed by  
  A)            any numbers of characters.  
  2. List all the filenames whose name starts with a single letter followed by a single  
  digit and then any number of alphanumeric characters.                               (5)  
  3. List all the filenames with exactly only having 3 letters.  
  4. List all the filenames having only alphabets.  
  5. List all the filenames whose extension is '.c' and '.txt'.  
  
  
  B)      Demonstrate any two options of 'ls' command.                                               (3)  
  C)      Illustrate the working of following commands:  
  
  1. mkdir                                                                                (2)  
  2. cd  
  
  
  3)           Construct a shell script to accept 2 strings as input and perform string concatenation.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Illustrate the meaning of following command lines.                                         (3)  
  i) cd dir1

  ii) vi test.sh  
  iii) sh test.sh  
  
  C)         Build the command line using redirection operators for the following:  
  i) Count the number entries in /etc/passwd.                                                (2)  
  ii) Create a new file without using vi editor.  
  
  4)              Construct a shell script to accept 'N' integers into an array and find the sum of array  
  elements.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Construct the command lines using 'sed' command:  
  
  1. Edit the word 'Unix' by 'Linux'.  
  2. Replace the word 'old' by 'new'.                                                    (3)  
  3. Delete all the lines having the word 'pathname'.  
  
  
  C)         Illustrate the differences between shell variables and user defined variables in Linux.    (2)  
  5)              Develop the appropriate vi editor commands for the following:  
  
  1. To open a new file with '.c' extension.  
  A)             2. Enter in to the 'insert mode'.  
  3. Save your work and exit to terminal.                                                (5)  
  4. Move the cursor 3 lines up.  
  5. Delete the entire current line.  
  
  
  B)         Build the 'awk' programming lines for the following:  
  
  1. Print the columns 1 and 5 from a file.  
  2. Perform the addition of the digits 5 and 8.                                         (3)  
  3. To check whether the value is 3rd column is greater than 100 or not.  
  
  
  C)         Rephrase the following command lines correctly as per their syntax:  
  
  1. -f -e \$ps                                                                           (2)  
  2. aux \$ps  
  
  
  -----End-----
